_note: Chapter 08 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: A flock of birds passed above the roof, and nobody in the room looked up.
ex.cn: 一群鸟从屋顶上空掠过，房间里没有人抬头。
ex.note: above 在…上方；above all 首先；over 与…上方（相叠）

ex.en: The teacher checked the accuracy of the figures before printing them.
ex.cn: 老师在付印前核对了这些数字的准确性。
ex.note: with accuracy 准确地；accuracy in … …方面的准确性

ex.en: "Cold" is an adjective, while "quickly" is an adverb.
ex.cn: 表示“冷”的那个词是形容词，而表示“很快地”的那个词是副词。
ex.note: an adjective for … …的形容词

ex.en: She is still young at the age of twenty-two.
ex.cn: 她二十二岁，还很年轻。
ex.note: at the age of … 在…岁时；the age of … …的时代

ex.en: She has aged a great deal since we last met.
ex.cn: 自从上次见面，她老了不少。
ex.note: age well 保养得好；be aging 正在变老

ex.en: Children learn the alphabet by singing a simple song.
ex.cn: 孩子们靠唱一首简单的歌学会了字母表。
ex.note: the English alphabet 英语字母表；in alphabetical order 按字母顺序

ex.en: He looked at the problem from a different angle.
ex.cn: 他换一个角度看待这个问题。
ex.note: at an angle 斜着；from another angle 从另一个角度；the angle of vision 视角

ex.en: The moon appeared above the ridge, and the wind dropped.
ex.cn: 月亮出现在山脊上方，风也停了。
ex.note: appear to do 似乎；it appears that … 据说

ex.en: The army had to cross the frozen river before the spring thaw.
ex.cn: 军队必须在春融之前渡过高冰的河。
ex.note: an army of 一大群；a great army of workers 大批工人

ex.en: People often associate the smell of pine with cold mountain air.
ex.cn: 人们常把松脂的气味和山中的寒气联系在一起。
ex.note: associate A with B 把 A 与 B 联系起来；associate with 与…交往

ex.en: He works as an associate in a law firm downtown.
ex.cn: 他在市中心一家律师事务所做合伙人。
ex.note: a business associate 生意伙伴；an associate partner 合伙人

ex.en: She was appointed associate director of the research centre.
ex.cn: 她被任命为研究中心的副主任。
ex.note: associate director 副主任；associate professor 副教授

ex.en: The local authority closed the road for repairs.
ex.cn: 地方政府封闭了这条路进行修缮。
ex.note: local authority 地方政府；have authority over 对…有权；a scholar of authority 权威学者

ex.en: They danced every waltz at the ball until the music stopped.
ex.cn: 他们一曲接一曲地跳着华尔兹，直到乐队停下。
ex.note: a ball 舞会；a ball game 球类运动；have a ball 玩得开心

ex.en: The bathroom window looked out onto the courtyard.
ex.cn: 卫生间的窗户正对着院子。
ex.note: in the bathroom 在浴室里；public bathroom 公共厕所

ex.en: The search for extra-terrestrial beings continues.
ex.cn: 寻找地外生命的搜寻仍在继续。
ex.note: human beings 人类；in being 存在；bring sth. into being 使某物产生

ex.en: A single bird called from the top of the dead tree.
ex.cn: 一只孤零零的鸟在枯树顶上鸣叫。
ex.note: a bird in the hand 一鸟在手；bird's-eye view 鸟瞰

ex.en: Wait until the water boils, then turn down the heat.
ex.cn: 等水开了，再把火调小。
ex.note: boil the water 把水烧开；at a boiling point 达到沸点

ex.en: He broke a dry branch from the tree to make a fire.
ex.cn: 他从树上折下一根干树枝来生火。
ex.note: a branch of the bank 银行的分行；branch office 分支机构

ex.en: The old building on the corner was covered in ivy.
ex.cn: 街角那栋旧楼爬满了常春藤。
ex.note: office building 办公楼；the building of … …的建造

ex.en: She calculated the cost of the trip before she agreed to go.
ex.cn: 在答应去之前，她先算清了这次出行的花费。
ex.note: calculate the cost of 估计…的成本；calculate on 指望

ex.en: A careless mistake in the report cost the team a contract.
ex.cn: 报告里一处粗心的错误让团队丢了一份合同。
ex.note: careless about 对…不细心；careless to do 疏忽地做

ex.en: He became a celebrity overnight after the broadcast.
ex.cn: 那次播出之后，他一夜之间成了名人。
ex.note: a media celebrity 媒体名人；celebrity status 名望

ex.en: The teacher drew a chart to show how sales had changed.
ex.cn: 老师画了一张图表，来说明销售情况的变化。
ex.note: a bar chart 柱状图；draw a chart 制图

ex.en: He charted the temperature every morning for a year.
ex.cn: 他连续一年每天早上记录气温。
ex.note: chart a course 规划航线；chart progress 记录进展

ex.en: You may choose either answer, but you must explain your reason.
ex.cn: 两个答案你可以任选一个，但必须说明理由。
ex.note: choose to do 决定做；choose between A and B 在…之间作出选择

ex.en: The sign was not clear, so we asked a local man for help.
ex.cn: 路牌上的字看不清，我们便向一位当地人问路。
ex.note: clear of 远离；in the clear 安全；a clear voice 清晰的声音

ex.en: Workers cleared the snow from the road before dawn.
ex.cn: 工人在天亮前把路上的积雪清走了。
ex.note: clear the way 扫清道路；clear up 放晴；洗清嫌疑

ex.en: The old wall collapsed under the weight of the wet snow.
ex.cn: 湿雪的重量压垮了那道老墙。
ex.note: collapse into 瘫倒；the collapse of … …的倒闭

ex.en: Good teachers communicate ideas clearly, not just facts.
ex.cn: 好老师传达的是清晰的思想，而不只是事实。
ex.note: communicate with 与…交流；communicate sth. to sb. 把…传达给某人

ex.en: Attendance at the weekly meeting is compulsory for all staff.
ex.cn: 全体员工都必须参加每周的例会。
ex.note: compulsory education 义务教育；make it compulsory to do 强制做

ex.en: The congress voted to raise the tax on imported goods.
ex.cn: 代表大会投票决定提高进口商品的税。
ex.note: a political congress 党的代表大会；in congress 在开会

ex.en: This drink contains too much sugar for me.
ex.cn: 这种饮料含糖太多，我喝不了。
ex.note: contain oneself 克制自己；be contained in 包含在…之内

ex.en: Few students cope well with the pressure of final exams.
ex.cn: 很少有学生能应付得了期末考试的压力。
ex.note: cope with 处理；cope with a difficult situation 应付困难局面

ex.en: It takes courage to admit that you were wrong.
ex.cn: 承认自己错了需要勇气。
ex.note: have the courage to do 有勇气做；courageous 有勇气的

ex.en: The newspaper criticized the plan for ignoring small farmers.
ex.cn: 这家报纸批评这项计划忽略了小农户。
ex.note: criticize sb. for sth. 因某事批评某人；英式拼写为 criticise

ex.en: It is the custom here to exchange small gifts at the new year.
ex.cn: 在这里，新年时互赠小礼物是习俗。
ex.note: by custom 依照惯例；customs office 海关；customs duty 关税

ex.en: The dealer offered a lower price for the second-hand car.
ex.cn: 车行给这辆二手车的报价更低。
ex.note: a car dealer 车商；a wholesale dealer 批发商

ex.en: "Will you come to the concert?" "Definitely," she said.
ex.cn: “你来听音乐会吗？”“一定来。”她说。
ex.note: definitely 是副词，不能直接修饰动词

ex.en: She described the old house in a few careful sentences.
ex.cn: 她用几个谨慎的句子描述了那座老房子。
ex.note: describe sb. as 把某人形容为；describe sth. to sb. 向某人描述

ex.en: The two ministers exchanged a short dialogue before the meeting.
ex.cn: 会前两位部长交换了简短的一段对话。
ex.note: in dialogue with 与…对话；a dialogue between A and B A 与 B 之间的对话

ex.en: The building was designed so that disabled visitors could enter easily.
ex.cn: 这座建筑设计得很方便残障人士进出。
ex.note: the disabled 残疾人（总称）；be disabled from doing 因…而不能做

ex.en: The village lay distant in the valley, a faint line of smoke above it.
ex.cn: 村子远远地落在谷里，屋顶上方浮着一线淡烟。
ex.note: distant from 远离；in the distant future 在遥远的将来

ex.en: A donkey pulled the cart slowly up the muddy lane.
ex.cn: 一头驴拉着车，沿着泥泞的小路慢慢往上走。
ex.note: as stubborn as a donkey 像驴一样倔；donkey years 漫长难熬的岁月

ex.en: The bus driver waited until everyone had taken a seat.
ex.cn: 公交司机一直等到所有人都坐下。
ex.note: a bus driver 公交司机；a hard disk driver 硬盘驱动器

ex.en: The earthquake struck at dawn, and the whole village shook.
ex.cn: 地震在黎明时分袭来，整个村子都在晃动。
ex.note: an earthquake hits … 地震袭击…；earthquake damage 震灾损失

ex.en: You can take either bus; they both go to the station.
ex.cn: 两趟车你随便搭哪一趟都行，它们都到火车站。
ex.note: either … or … 或者…或者…；neither … nor … 两者都不

ex.en: The play tells the story of an emperor who fears his own court.
ex.cn: 这出戏讲的是一位连朝臣都心生畏惧的皇帝。
ex.note: the emperor 皇帝；an empress 女王

ex.en: Please enter your name and student number on the form.
ex.cn: 请在表格上填上你的姓名和学号。
ex.note: enter into 进入（讨论）；enter a competition 参加比赛

ex.en: Experts estimate that the repairs will take six months.
ex.cn: 专家估计修缮要花六个月。
ex.note: estimate the cost of 估计…的成本；an estimated 估计的

ex.en: The repair cost was far above the original estimate.
ex.cn: 维修费用远远高出了最初的估价。
ex.note: at an estimated cost of 估价…；a rough estimate 粗略估计

ex.en: An excess of sugar in the diet is bad for the teeth.
ex.cn: 饮食中糖分过量对牙齿有害。
ex.note: in excess of 超过；an excess of 过多

ex.en: The airline asked passengers to leave their excess baggage at the gate.
ex.cn: 航空公司要求乘客把超重行李留在登机口。
ex.note: excess baggage 超重行李；excess profit 超额利润

ex.en: The explosion could be heard three streets away.
ex.cn: 爆炸声在三条街外都听得见。
ex.note: an explosion of anger 突然发怒；an explosion of prices 价格暴涨

ex.en: In the story, a fairy grants the girl three wishes.
ex.cn: 故事里，一位仙女给了那女孩三个愿望。
ex.note: fairy tale 童话；tooth fairy 牙仙

ex.en: The engine stopped because of a fault in the fuel line.
ex.cn: 发动机熄火了，因为输油管路出了故障。
ex.note: at fault 有错；find fault with 挑毛病；a fault in … …的故障

ex.en: A fierce wind tore the leaves from the old trees.
ex.cn: 一阵猛烈的风把老树的叶子扯了下来。
ex.note: a fierce storm 猛烈的风暴；fierce competition 激烈的竞争

ex.en: The camera flashed twice before the shot was finished.
ex.cn: 照片还没拍完，相机就闪了两下。
ex.note: flash across 掠过；flash back to 闪回；flash into 使闪现

ex.en: There was a flash of lightning, followed by a loud crash of thunder.
ex.cn: 一道闪电划过，随后是一声震耳的雷鸣。
ex.note: in a flash 瞬间；a flash of 一道…；闪光灯 flash

ex.en: The sign at the foot of the hill read: "No vehicles."
ex.cn: 山脚下的牌子上写着：“禁止车辆通行。”
ex.note: at the foot of 在…脚下；on foot 步行；six feet high 六英尺高

ex.en: The fountain in the square was frozen solid.
ex.cn: 广场上的喷泉冻得结结实实。
ex.note: a fountain of knowledge 知识的源泉；fountain pen 钢笔

ex.en: The price of fuel has risen again this winter.
ex.cn: 今年冬天燃料的价格又涨了。
ex.note: fuel for thought 思想的动力；run out of fuel 燃料耗尽

ex.en: Rallying cries fuelled the crowd's anger.
ex.cn: 呐喊声助长了人群的怒气。
ex.note: fuel inflation 加剧通货膨胀；fuel sb.'s ambition 助长某人的野心

ex.en: Please wait at the gate until your number is called.
ex.cn: 请在门口等候，叫到您的号码再进来。
ex.note: the gates of … …的大门；boarding gate 登机口

ex.en: The sky was grey and gloomy, and the wind had a raw edge.
ex.cn: 天是灰暗阴沉的，风里带着刀割似的凉意。
ex.note: a gloomy outlook 悲观的前景；look gloomy 神情阴郁

ex.en: The finest grain of the wheat is used to make flour.
ex.cn: 最细的小麦颗粒用来磨面粉。
ex.note: a grain of sand 一粒沙；grains of truth 真理的片段

ex.en: These beans grow quickly in warm, wet soil.
ex.cn: 这些豆子在温暖湿润的土里长得很快。
ex.note: grow into 成长为；grow up 长大；be grown 种植

ex.en: The doctor noted the patient's name in his own handwriting.
ex.cn: 医生用自己的笔迹记下了病人的名字。
ex.note: neat handwriting 工整的字迹；a handwriting sample 笔迹样本

ex.en: A short walk after dinner is good for your health.
ex.cn: 晚饭后散一会儿步对健康有好处。
ex.note: be in good health 身体健康；health care 医疗保健；public health 公共卫生

ex.en: He tried to hide his fear of the examination.
ex.cn: 他试图掩饰自己对考试的害怕。
ex.note: hide sth. from sb. 把某事瞒着某人；hide behind 躲在…后面

ex.en: The old chair was covered with the hide of a deer.
ex.cn: 那把旧椅子上蒙着一层鹿皮。
ex.note: hide 兽皮（不可数）；hides 皮革（复数）

ex.en: He hung his coat on a hook behind the door.
ex.cn: 他把外套挂在门后的钩子上。
ex.note: by the hook 碰巧；hook and line 钓鱼

ex.en: The title of the book hooked me from the very first page.
ex.cn: 这本书的书名从第一页就把我吸引住了。
ex.note: be hooked on 对…上瘾；hook up 连接

ex.en: Hunger drove him to work three days without food.
ex.cn: 饥饿驱使着他三天没吃一口东西地干活。
ex.note: hunger for 对…的渴望；satisfy hunger 消除饥饿

ex.en: Imagine living by the sea with no telephone in sight.
ex.cn: 想象一下住在海边、眼前连一部电话都没有的日子。
ex.note: imagine doing 想象做；imagine sb. to be 想象某人是…

ex.en: The number of online shoppers has increased sharply in recent years.
ex.cn: 网购人数近年来急剧增加。
ex.note: an increase in … …的增长；increase by 增加了

ex.en: My initial reaction to the offer was plain surprise.
ex.cn: 我对这个提议的第一反应是惊讶。
ex.note: initial impression 初步印象；initial letter 首字母

ex.en: Please write your initials in the top corner of the form.
ex.cn: 请把你的姓名首字母写在表格右上角。
ex.note: the initials of … …的首字母

ex.en: Farmers in this region pay heavy insurance on their crops.
ex.cn: 这个地区的农民为农作物要缴很高的保险费。
ex.note: health insurance 医疗保险；take out insurance 投保

ex.en: The company plans to invest heavily in new research.
ex.cn: 公司打算在新研究上投入巨资。
ex.note: invest in 投资于；invest time in 把时间投入

ex.en: Several classmates joined us at the station.
ex.cn: 有几个同学在车站跟我们汇合。
ex.note: join in 参加（活动）；join hands 手拉手；join A to B 把 A 与 B 连接

ex.en: What kind of music do you listen to on the way to work?
ex.cn: 你上班路上听什么类型的音乐？
ex.note: a kind of 一种；this kind of 这类；kind of 有点儿

ex.en: It was kind of her to wait until I had finished.
ex.cn: 她一直等到我做完，真是好心。
ex.note: be kind to sb. 对某人友善；It's kind of you to … 谢谢你…

ex.en: Red lanterns hung along the street for the festival.
ex.cn: 为了过节，街上挂起了红灯笼。
ex.note: a paper lantern 纸灯笼；lantern light 灯光

ex.en: He learned from the newspaper that the road was closed.
ex.cn: 他从报纸上得知那条路封了。
ex.note: learn of/about 听说；learn to do 学会做

ex.en: The old book lies open on the desk where he left it.
ex.cn: 那本旧书摊开放在他离开时的书桌上。
ex.note: lie about 撒谎；lie in 在于；lie on 位于…上

ex.en: He realized that the story he had heard was a complete lie.
ex.cn: 他意识到自己听来的那个故事完全是个谎言。
ex.note: tell a lie 撒谎；a white lie 善意的谎言

ex.en: She bought a loaf of bread and a jar of jam.
ex.cn: 她买了一条面包和一瓶果酱。
ex.note: a loaf of bread 一条面包；half a loaf 半条面包

ex.en: Good luck with the exam; I am sure you will do well.
ex.cn: 祝你考试顺利，我相信你一定考得好。
ex.note: good luck with 在…上祝好运；try one's luck 碰运气

ex.en: The company changed its management last spring.
ex.cn: 公司去年春天更换了管理层。
ex.note: under the management of 在…的管理下；management training 管理培训

ex.en: "May you have a long and happy life," she said to the old man.
ex.cn: 她对老人说：“愿您长命百岁。”
ex.note: may well 很可能；May I …? 我可以…吗？

ex.en: The merchant weighed the grain and paid in cash.
ex.cn: 商人称了谷物的分量，用现金付了钱。
ex.note: a wine merchant 酒商；a merchant ship 商船

ex.en: Only a small minority of the students failed the test.
ex.cn: 只有少数学生没通过考试。
ex.note: a minority of … …的少数；be in the minority 处于少数地位

ex.en: The club meets once a month to review the monthly plan.
ex.cn: 俱乐部每月碰一次头，检查当月的计划。
ex.note: monthly report 月报；monthly rent 月租

ex.en: The fee is paid monthly rather than in one lump sum.
ex.cn: 这笔费用按月支付，而不是一次付清。
ex.note: pay monthly 按月付款；twice monthly 每月两次

ex.en: The magazine is a well-known monthly on modern art.
ex.cn: 这本杂志是一份知名的现代艺术月刊。
ex.note: a monthly magazine 月刊；an academic monthly 学术月刊

ex.en: The police believed that the clerk had been murdered.
ex.cn: 警方相信那名职员是被谋杀的。
ex.note: murder sb. 谋杀某人；a murder case 谋杀案

ex.en: She wrote a neat summary of the long report.
ex.cn: 她把那份长报告写成了一份简洁明了的摘要。
ex.note: neat and tidy 整洁；a neat solution 巧妙的办法

ex.en: The final exam was a nightmare for most of the class.
ex.cn: 期末考试对班上大多数人来说是一场噩梦。
ex.note: a nightmare scenario 最坏的情况；have a nightmare 做噩梦

ex.en: He finished his first novel while he was still a student.
ex.cn: 他还在当学生时就写完了自己的第一部小说。
ex.note: a historical novel 历史小说；in the novel 在小说中

ex.en: The team came up with a novel way of storing old books.
ex.cn: 这个团队想出了一个存放旧书的新奇办法。
ex.note: a novel idea 新奇的想法；novel design 新颖的设计

ex.en: It never occurred to him that the shop was already closed.
ex.cn: 他压根儿没想到那家店已经关门了。
ex.note: occur to sb. 某人想到；an accident occurred 事故发生了

ex.en: She can operate the machine, but she has never repaired it.
ex.cn: 这台机器她会操作，却从没拆修过。
ex.note: operate on a patient 给病人做手术；operate a business 经营生意

ex.en: Theirs is smaller, but ours is cheaper.
ex.cn: 他们那个更小，不过我们的更便宜。
ex.note: ourselves 我们自己；of our own 我们自己的

ex.en: He set off at a slow pace, watching the fields.
ex.cn: 他迈着慢步出发，一路看着田野。
ex.note: at a fast pace 快速地；keep pace with 跟上

ex.en: She paced up and down the corridor, waiting for news.
ex.cn: 她在走廊里来回踱步，等着消息。
ex.note: pace oneself 控制自己的节奏；pace the horse 控制马速

ex.en: The lecture was only a partial explanation of the theory.
ex.cn: 那次讲座只是对这一理论作了部分解释。
ex.note: be partial to 对…偏爱；a partial success 部分成功

ex.en: A basket of peaches sat on the kitchen table.
ex.cn: 厨房桌上放着一篮桃子。
ex.note: a peach of a thing 好极的东西；peach blossom 桃花

ex.en: Her calm personality won the trust of the villagers.
ex.cn: 她沉静的个性赢得了乡亲们的信任。
ex.note: a strong personality 强烈的个性；a television personality 电视名人

ex.en: Two stone pillars marked the entrance to the old hall.
ex.cn: 两根石柱标示着老礼堂的入口。
ex.note: a pillar of society 社会中坚；a pillar of support 支柱

ex.en: He plunged his hands into the cold water and pulled the rope.
ex.cn: 他双手探进冰冷的水里，一把抓住了绳子。
ex.note: plunge into 跳入；投入；plunge into darkness 陷入黑暗

ex.en: The village ate pork and dumplings on the eve of the festival.
ex.cn: 过节前夕，全村人吃猪肉和饺子。
ex.note: pork chop 猪排；roast pork 烤猪肉

ex.en: Regular practice makes good English listening possible.
ex.cn: 经常练习才能练出好的英语听力。
ex.note: in practice 实际上；practice doing 练习做

ex.en: The village priest blessed the new school at the ceremony.
ex.cn: 村里的神父在典礼上为新学校祝福。
ex.note: a Catholic priest 天主教神父；the high priest 祭司长

ex.en: The shop made little profit during the winter months.
ex.cn: 这家店在冬季的几个月里利润很薄。
ex.note: make a profit 盈利；profit from 从…中获利

ex.en: Both sides profited from the deal, though neither said so.
ex.cn: 双方都从这笔交易中得了利，尽管谁也没说。
ex.note: profit from 从…中获益；profit by 因…而获益

ex.en: The film is a careful psychological study of a lonely man.
ex.cn: 这部电影是对一个孤独者的心理剖析，写得很细致。
ex.note: psychological stress 心理压力；psychological warfare 心理战

ex.en: In the legend, the queen hides the key under the stone.
ex.cn: 传说中，王后把钥匙藏在石头下面。
ex.note: the queen consort 王后；queen bee 蜂王

ex.en: The path was rather rough, and his shoes soon filled with mud.
ex.cn: 那条路相当难走，他的鞋很快就灌满了泥。
ex.note: would rather 宁愿；rather than 而不是；or rather 更确切地说

ex.en: I didn't recognize you with your hair cut short.
ex.cn: 你把头发剪短了，我都没认出你来。
ex.note: recognize sb. by … 通过…认出某人；recognize that … 承认…；英式拼写为 recognise

ex.en: The law is meant to regulate the hours banks may stay open.
ex.cn: 这项法律旨在规定银行可以开门的时间。
ex.note: regulate trade 调控贸易；regulate temperature 调节温度

ex.en: It will cost more to repair the roof than to replace it.
ex.cn: 修屋顶的钱比换掉它还多。
ex.note: under repair 在维修中；repair the damage 弥补损失

ex.en: His father earned the respect of every man in the village.
ex.cn: 他父亲赢得了村里每一个人的尊重。
ex.note: respect sb.'s wishes 尊重某人的意愿；with respect to 关于

ex.en: In this respect, the two villages are hard to tell apart.
ex.cn: 在这方面，两个村子几乎难以分辨。
ex.note: in this respect 在这方面；with respect to 关于

ex.en: He rode the bus to the station and walked the rest of the way.
ex.cn: 他坐公交到车站，剩下的路步行走完。
ex.note: ride a horse 骑马；ride a bus 乘公交

ex.en: The ride from the station to the village took half an hour.
ex.cn: 从车站到村子里那趟车要坐半个小时。
ex.note: a bus ride 乘车；a short ride 短途旅行

ex.en: We took a rough path through the woods to avoid the main road.
ex.cn: 我们走了一条穿过林子的难走的路，避开大路。
ex.note: rough estimate 粗略估计；a rough draft 草稿；rough treatment 粗暴对待

ex.en: He earns a modest salary as an assistant at the clinic.
ex.cn: 他在诊所当助手，挣一份不算高的工资。
ex.note: monthly salary 月薪；a salary increase 涨工资

ex.en: From the top of the hill the scenery is magnificent.
ex.cn: 从山顶望去，风景壮丽。
ex.note: natural scenery 自然风光；scenery 是不可数名词

ex.en: The service sector now employs more people than the farms do.
ex.cn: 服务业现在雇用的人比农业还多。
ex.note: the private sector 私营部门；a sector of the economy 经济的某个部门

ex.en: The training sessions are held twice a week in the hall.
ex.cn: 培训课每周在礼堂举行两次。
ex.note: a training session 培训课；in session 正在开会

ex.en: The moon shines on the snow, and the whole street turns white.
ex.cn: 月光照在雪上，整条街都变得煞白。
ex.note: shine in 表现出色；the sun shines 阳光照耀

ex.en: The teacher collected the signatures of all the parents.
ex.cn: 老师收齐了所有家长的签名。
ex.note: put one's signature to 在…上签名；a signature dish 拿手菜

ex.en: Every winter the children learn to ski on the frozen lake.
ex.cn: 每年冬天孩子们都在结冰的湖上学滑雪。
ex.note: ski resort 滑雪胜地；go skiing 去滑雪

ex.en: He rented a pair of skis for the whole week.
ex.cn: 他租了一整周的滑雪板。
ex.note: a pair of skis 一双滑雪板；ski boots 滑雪靴

ex.en: He snapped a photograph of the whole family before dinner.
ex.cn: 晚饭前，他给全家人拍了一张照片。
ex.note: snap at sb. 对某人厉声说话；snap a photo 快速拍照

ex.en: She showed me a snap of the two of them at the gate.
ex.cn: 她给我看了一张他们在门口的照片。
ex.note: in a snap 立刻；a quick snap 快照

ex.en: I left my notebook somewhere between the library and the hall.
ex.cn: 我把笔记本丢在图书馆和礼堂之间的什么地方了。
ex.note: somewhere else 别处；somewhere around 大约在

ex.en: She was not complaining about the noise, but specifically about the late hours.
ex.cn: 她抱怨的不是噪音，而具体是那些太晚的时辰。
ex.note: more specifically 更具体地说；specifically speaking 具体来说

ex.en: By spring, the fields were green and the streams were loud again.
ex.cn: 到了春天，田野绿了，溪水又响了起来。
ex.note: in spring 在春天；spring water 泉水；a metal spring 金属弹簧

ex.en: New plans began to spring up after the discussion ended.
ex.cn: 讨论结束后，新的计划开始冒出来。
ex.note: spring up 涌现；spring to one's feet 一跃而起

ex.en: The tools in his workshop are all made of steel.
ex.cn: 他作坊里的工具全是钢制的。
ex.note: steel industry 钢铁工业；steely 钢铁般的

ex.en: She drank the cold juice through a paper straw.
ex.cn: 她用纸吸管喝着冰凉的果汁。
ex.note: a straw hat 草帽；drink through a straw 用吸管喝

ex.en: They moved to a quiet suburb to escape the noise of the city.
ex.cn: 他们搬到安静的郊区，躲开城市的喧闹。
ex.note: in the suburbs 在郊区；a residential suburb 住宅区

ex.en: The view from the ridge was superb, and no one spoke for a while.
ex.cn: 山脊上的景色极好，一时间谁也没说话。
ex.note: superb scenery 绝妙的风景；a superb performance 出色的演出

ex.en: Her voice was so sweet that the whole hall fell silent.
ex.cn: 她的声音如此悦耳，整个大厅都静了下来。
ex.note: a sweet voice 悦耳的嗓音；sweet dreams 做个好梦

ex.en: The old man kept a jar of sweets on the shelf.
ex.cn: 老人在架子上放着一罐糖果。
ex.note: a bag of sweets 一袋糖果；sweets 甜点（复数）

ex.en: The government raised the tax on imported oil last year.
ex.cn: 政府去年提高了进口石油的税。
ex.note: pay taxes 纳税；a tax on sth. 某物的税；a tax on sb.'s nerves 神经负担

ex.en: The new rule taxes small shops more heavily than large ones.
ex.cn: 新规定对小店的征税比大店重。
ex.note: tax sb. sth. 对某人某物征税；be taxed with 承受着…的重担

ex.en: The final term of the year is the busiest one.
ex.cn: 一年中最后一个学期是最忙的。
ex.note: in terms of 就…而言；a term of office 任期

ex.en: The snow was so thick that the doors would not open.
ex.cn: 雪太厚了，门都推不开。
ex.note: thick soup 浓汤；through thick and thin 不顾艰难

ex.en: He studied the map for a long time and thus found the right path.
ex.cn: 他对着地图看了很久，就这样找到了那条正确的路。
ex.note: thus far 迄今为止；thus 因此

ex.en: Tomorrow the whole village will gather at the hall.
ex.cn: 明天，全村人都会聚集在大礼堂。
ex.note: the day after tomorrow 后天；tomorrow morning 明天早上

ex.en: The early train leaves the city at six in the morning.
ex.cn: 清早那班火车六点离开城市。
ex.note: by train 乘火车；a train of thought 一连串想法

ex.en: New staff are trained for two weeks before they work alone.
ex.cn: 新员工先培训两周，然后才能独立上岗。
ex.note: train sb. to do 训练某人做；train for a race 为比赛训练

ex.en: A troop of children ran out of the classroom at once.
ex.cn: 一群孩子立刻从教室里跑了出去。
ex.note: a troop of 一群；a troop of horses 一群马

ex.en: The ultimate aim of the course is to write clearly.
ex.cn: 这门课的最终目的，是把话写清楚。
ex.note: the ultimate goal 最终目标；ultimate reality 根本的现实

ex.en: It is unlikely that the storm will reach the coast tonight.
ex.cn: 暴风雨今晚到达海岸的可能性不大。
ex.note: unlikely to do 不太可能做；it is unlikely that … …不太可能

ex.en: All the talk about fixing the road by Friday was in vain.
ex.cn: 关于周五之前修好那条路的一番话全是白说。
ex.note: in vain 徒劳；vain effort 白费力气；be vain about 自负

ex.en: The village has one shop, one school and a hundred houses.
ex.cn: 这个村子有一家商店、一所学校和一百户人家。
ex.note: village life 乡村生活；the whole village 全村

ex.en: The dock workers asked for a higher wage after the freeze.
ex.cn: 码头工人在冰冻之后要求更高的工资。
ex.note: a day's wage 一天的工钱；the wage of a day 日薪

ex.en: The two sides waged a long and bitter argument over the plan.
ex.cn: 双方就这个方案展开了一场漫长而激烈的争论。
ex.note: wage a campaign 发起一场运动；wage war on 对…发动战争

ex.en: He was wearing a thick coat and gloves against the cold.
ex.cn: 他穿着厚大衣，戴着手套抵御寒冷。
ex.note: wear out 用坏；wear one's heart on one's sleeve 毫不掩饰

ex.en: Winter wear is sold at half price after the festival.
ex.cn: 过节之后，冬季服装半价出售。
ex.note: everyday wear 日常穿着；show wear 有磨损

ex.en: She enjoys city life, whereas her brother prefers the country.
ex.cn: 她喜欢城市生活，而她哥哥更愿意待在乡下。
ex.note: whereas 表对比；作“鉴于”讲时相当于 since

ex.en: A bird with a broken wing hopped along the fence.
ex.cn: 一只翅膀受伤的鸟沿着篱笆一蹦一跳地走。
ex.note: the left wing 左翼；on the wing 在飞行中

ex.en: Every year the villagers come here to worship at the temple.
ex.cn: 每年村民们都来这里在庙里烧香。
ex.note: worship God 崇拜上帝；a place of worship 礼拜场所

ex.en: I hope your holiday brings you rest and good luck.
ex.cn: 希望你的假期给你带来休息和好运。
ex.note: your 你的/你们的；yours 你的（东西）
